excluded.name: Winter Camp
excluded.reason: Held in January or February, outside summer.

cards.name: Summer Camp
cards.description: Children with amputations or limb differences participate in rafting, ropes courses, zip-lining, swimming and adaptive water sports. Campers stay at Nantahala Outdoor Center.

season.text: Summer Camp is held for 5 days during the 2nd week in July.

financial_aid.text: Campers never pay a fee. Families never receive a bill.

special_needs.text: All activities are modified as necessary to meet the ability and interest level of each camper.

lunch.text: These funds help cover camper lodging, meals, activities, transportation (including charter bus from Atlanta), gear, volunteer support, and rising costs due to inflation.

transportation.text: These funds help cover camper lodging, meals, activities, transportation (including charter bus from Atlanta), gear, volunteer support, and rising costs due to inflation.
